metadata.description: The organization develops system and communications protection procedures to facilitate the implementation of the system and communications protection policy and associated system and communications protection controls.

metadata.title: CCI-001079
metadata.description: Disseminates to organization-defined personnel or roles the procedures to facilitate the implementation of the system and communications protection policy and associated system and communications protection controls.

metadata.title: CCI-001080
metadata.description: Review and update the current system and communications protection procedures in accordance with organization-defined frequency.

metadata.title: CCI-001081
metadata.description: Defines the frequency for reviewing and updating the current system and communications protection procedures.

metadata.title: CCI-001082
metadata.description: Separate user functionality, including user interface services, from system management functionality.

metadata.title: CCI-001083
metadata.description: Prevent the presentation of system management functionality at an interface for non-privileged users.

metadata.title: CCI-001084
metadata.description: Isolate security functions from nonsecurity functions.

metadata.title: CCI-001085
metadata.description: Employ hardware separation mechanisms to implement security function isolation.

metadata.title: CCI-001086
metadata.description: Isolate security functions enforcing access and information flow control from both nonsecurity functions and from other security functions.

metadata.title: CCI-001087
metadata.description: The organization implements an information system isolation boundary to minimize the number of nonsecurity functions included within the boundary containing security functions.

metadata.title: CCI-001088
metadata.description: The organization implements security functions as largely independent modules that avoid unnecessary interactions between modules.

metadata.title: CCI-001089
metadata.description: Implement security functions as a layered structure minimizing interactions between layers of the design and avoiding any dependence by lower layers on the functionality or correctness of higher layers.

metadata.title: CCI-001090
metadata.description: Prevent unauthorized and unintended information transfer via shared system resources.

metadata.title: CCI-001091
metadata.description: The information system does not share resources that are used to interface with systems operating at different security levels.

metadata.title: CCI-001092
metadata.description: The information system protects against or limits the effects of the organization-defined or referenced types of denial of service attacks.

metadata.title: CCI-001093
metadata.description: Defines the types of denial-of-service events for protecting against or limiting the effects of the denial-of-service events.

metadata.title: CCI-001094
metadata.description: Restrict the ability of individuals to launch organization-defined denial of service attacks against other systems.

metadata.title: CCI-001095
metadata.description: Manage capacity, bandwidth, or other redundancy to limit the effects of information flooding types of denial-of-service attacks.

metadata.title: CCI-001096
metadata.description: The information system limits the use of resources by priority.

metadata.title: CCI-001097
metadata.description: Monitor and control communications at the external managed interfaces to the system and at key managed interfaces within the system.

metadata.title: CCI-001098
metadata.description: Connect to external networks or systems only through managed interfaces consisting of boundary protection devices arranged in accordance with an organizational security architecture.

metadata.title: CCI-001099
metadata.description: The organization physically allocates publicly accessible information system components to separate subnetworks with separate physical network interfaces.

metadata.title: CCI-001100
metadata.description: The information system prevents public access into the organization's internal networks except as appropriately mediated by managed interfaces employing boundary protection devices.

metadata.title: CCI-001101
metadata.description: Limit the number of external network connections to the system.

metadata.title: CCI-001102
metadata.description: Implement a managed interface for each external telecommunication service.

metadata.title: CCI-001103
metadata.description: Establish a traffic flow policy for each managed interface for each external telecommunication service.

metadata.title: CCI-001104
metadata.description: The organization employs security controls as needed to protect the confidentiality and integrity of the information being transmitted.

metadata.title: CCI-001105
metadata.description: Document each exception to the traffic flow policy with a supporting mission or business need and duration of that need.

metadata.title: CCI-001106
metadata.description: Review exceptions to the traffic flow policy on an organization-defined frequency for each external telecommunication service.

metadata.title: CCI-001107
metadata.description: Defines a frequency for the review of exceptions to the traffic flow policy for each external telecommunication service.

metadata.title: CCI-001108
metadata.description: Remove traffic flow policy exceptions that are no longer supported by an explicit mission or business need for each external telecommunication service.

metadata.title: CCI-001109
metadata.description: Deny network communications traffic by default and allow network communications traffic by exception at managed interfaces; and/or for organization-defined systems.

metadata.title: CCI-001110
metadata.description: The organization prevents the unauthorized release of information outside of the information system boundary or any unauthorized communication through the information system boundary when there is an operational failure of the boundary protection mechanisms.
